description: This file defines tools and data structures for interacting with GitHub, including retrieving user details, team information, and team members via GitHub API and GraphQL. It includes functions to create tools for fetching authenticated user info, user teams, and team members, utilizing external GitHub SDKs and custom error handling.

classes.name: UserDetails
classes.description: Contains additional fields about a GitHub user not present in MinimalUser, used for detailed user info.

classes.name: TeamInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a GitHub team, including name, slug, and description.

classes.name: OrganizationTeams
classes.description: Holds organization login and associated teams.

methods.name: GetMe
methods.description: Creates a tool to retrieve details of the authenticated GitHub user.

methods.name: GetTeams
methods.description: Creates a tool to fetch details of teams the user is a member of.

methods.name: GetTeamMembers
methods.description: Creates a tool to get member usernames of a specific team within an organization.
